text: Six-language glossary: Scientific, Technical, Philosophical, Poetic, Color, Vibration. The six languages = ENKI unit prototype.
The seventh language (الكلمة) was not yet named but already implied.
Color-vibration mapping (deterministic, silent). Colors are not decorative — they are signal maps.
